doc:
# SYK — JTGravity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “SYK model”).

claims.name: framework_applied_multipartite_entanglement_syk
claims.statement: The framework is applied to multipartite entanglement in SYK$_4$, SYK$_2$, mass-deformed SYK, sparse SYK, and $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric SYK model.

sources.title: Probing the Hierarchy of Genuine Multipartite Entanglement with Generalized Latent Entropy

claims.name: generalized_syk_model_has_same
claims.statement: The generalized SYK model has the same zero temperature entropy at each site as the SYK model.

sources.title: Local criticality, diffusion and chaos in generalized Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models

claims.name: syk_lattice_spatially_local_generalisation
claims.statement: The SYK lattice is a spatially local generalisation of the SYK model.

sources.title: All-order fluctuating hydrodynamics of the SYK lattice

claims.name: generalgraph_syk_model_includes_original
claims.statement: The general-graph SYK model includes the original SYK model and the (1+1)-d chain model as special cases.

sources.title: Local criticality, diffusion and chaos in generalized Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models

claims.name: doublescaling_syk_dssyk_model_controlled
claims.statement: The double-scaling SYK (DS-SYK) model is controlled by a parameter $q$.

sources.title: Quantum groups, non-commutative $AdS_2$, and chords in the double-scaled SYK model

claims.name: specific_supersymmetric_model_interpolates_between
claims.statement: A specific supersymmetric model interpolates between the chaotic $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK model and an integrable $\mathcal{N}=2$ "commuting" SYK model.

sources.title: Chaos-Integrability Transition in the BPS Subspace of the $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK Model

claims.name: syk_model_maximally_chaotic
claims.statement: The SYK model is maximally chaotic.

sources.title: The Spectrum in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model

claims.name: connection_between_sachdevyekitaev_syk_model
claims.statement: The connection between the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and the random coupling model provides new physical contexts in which to realize the SYK model.

sources.title: Random coupling model of turbulence as a classical Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model

claims.name: nonhermitian_two_coupled_sachdevyekitaev_syk
claims.statement: A non-Hermitian two coupled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model can have thermodynamic structure equivalent to a Hermitian two coupled SYK model.

sources.title: Non-Hermitian quantum system generated from two coupled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models

claims.name: show_sre_mathrm_syk_model
claims.statement: We show that the SRE for the $\mathrm{SYK_2}$ model equilibrates rapidly, but that in the steady-state the interacting chaotic SYK model has more magic than the simple $\mathrm{SYK_2}$.

claims.name: syk_boundary_states_provide_variational
claims.statement: SYK boundary states provide a variational approximation to the ground state of the mass-deformed SYK model.

sources.title: Quantum Chaos, Thermodynamics and Black Hole Microstates in the mass deformed SYK model

claims.name: syk_model_exhibits_chaotic_dynamics
claims.statement: The 2D SYK model exhibits chaotic dynamics.

claims.name: syk_model_exhibits_conformal_invariance
claims.statement: The 2D SYK model exhibits conformal invariance.

claims.name: syk_model_has_been_proposed
claims.statement: The SYK model has been proposed as a model of holography.

sources.title: The Spectrum in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model

claims.name: hypercube_model_not_local_unlike
claims.statement: The hypercube model is not $p$-local, unlike the SYK model.

sources.title: Parisi's hypercube, Fock-space fluxes, and the microscopics of near-AdS$_2$/near-CFT$_1$ duality

claims.name: fermions_sachdevyekitaev_syk_model_coupled
claims.statement: Fermions in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model coupled weakly to a bath of another SYK model are prepared in the thermofield double (TFD) state.

sources.title: Probing Evaporating Black Holes with Modular Flow in SYK

claims.name: partially_disorderaveraged_syk_model_introduced
claims.statement: A partially disorder-averaged SYK model is introduced with a real parameter that smoothly interpolates between the ordinary totally disorder-averaged SYK model and the totally fixed-coupling model.

sources.title: Factorizing Wormholes in a Partially Disorder-Averaged SYK Model

claims.name: statistics_supersymmetric_syk_model_interpreted
claims.statement: The statistics of the supersymmetric SYK model can be interpreted as random matrix theory ensembles with a different eight-fold classification from the original SYK model

sources.title: Supersymmetric SYK model and random matrix theory
